verdict.rationale: Keycloak documents realm-level export/import in JSON (an open format) and export/import of authorization configuration, giving admins a way to extract configuration and user data in a non-proprietary format, but there is no evidence of an end-user self-service 'export my data and leave' feature akin to GDPR data portability in the Account Console. missing for 10: end-user-initiated personal data export, documentation of full data completeness/interoperability guarantees, independent confirmation that exported JSON captures all user data.
